# YouTD 2 data (third-party)

Tower, item, aura, autocast and ability property tables from
[YouTD 2](https://github.com/Praytic/youtd2), used under the MIT license (see `LICENSE`).
YouTD 2 is based on "YouTD", a Warcraft III mod created by geX and the YouTD community.

Only the MIT-licensed data tables are included. YouTD 2 art, icons and text assets
(CC-BY-NC 4.0) are not used. In-game ability descriptions are generated from the
ported mechanics rather than copied.

`tools/import-youtd2.mjs` converts these tables into `src/data/youtd/generated.js`.
The upstream commit is recorded in `SOURCE_COMMIT`.
